seed: Shift Command I is two commands: File > Import Media (the video mock's key) and Photoshop's Edit > Invert Selection. With a marquee drawn on a picture it must stay Invert Selection and import nothing. At Next defaults, no flag set.

steps.comment: A recording first: it is what gives the probe a live menu bar in this set, and the key has to reach the menu to prove anything.
The log line names which menu row took the chord: it must be Edit > Invert Selection.
Inverted: everything but the marquee, whose outline's box is now the whole picture.

steps.note: With a marquee up, Shift Command I inverted the selection, as in Photoshop, and imported nothing
